title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we are! Our first stop is SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, an opportunity to enjoy sports with my friends!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, given the occasion, we've decided to raise the stakes just a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stakes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You'll play a series of one-on-one matches against us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For each match you win, our lunch plans for after this will be upgraded by one level.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For each match... Meaning, if I win all three matches I can expect a truly extravagant luncheon?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know about extravagant... But that's the idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. Even if you lose every match, you'll still get a satisfactory lunch for sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Me, lose every match? Unthinkable! I'll secure three victories with grace and panache!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, someone's motivated☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we go, then? The stage for our clash shall be the table tennis room.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Eat this!
Magical Dream Pegasus Smash!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, so cool! Okay, I'll do one too! Let's see... Sparkling Rainbow Special Strike!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You returned my Magical Dream Pegasus Smash?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... In that case...
Try my Technical Revolution Pegasus Smash!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: None of these sound like table tennis techniques.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, wow! They're keeping the rally going so well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa's match point is on the line, after all. It's little wonder they're both so heated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh, no matter where I hit it he sends it right back. He's so persistent! But I can't let myself lose to Tsuka—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How kind of you to lob the ball, Nene!
Here I go! Pegasus... Smaaash!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Two more points and I win!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not bad. But I've found my rhythm now. The real match starts here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Go, Tsukasa! Go, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I win here, I'll have secured three wins.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Surely an unbelievably luxurious lunch will be waiting for me...and so!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This victory goes...to me!!!
One hour later
Foothills

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I admit it, I did lose to Rui. I couldn't stand up to his trick shots once he got serious...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... I won twice, you know? So why... Why...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are we in the mountaaaiiins?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly the reaction we predicted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry, the bug spray we used is pretty strong.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that is a relief to hear... But not the point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What kind of luncheon are we supposed to have in the mountains?! There's not a single eatery in sight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll explain everything, so just settle down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, we're in the mountains, but that's because we want you to enjoy freshly harvested ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What does that mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You remember the clearing we passed on the way to the trail? That's a barbeque rental site.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This area also grows many wild greens. All of the species listed on this pamphlet are free for the taking.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Free for the taking... You mean we can enjoy as much of these as we like?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ding ding ding☆ And it's not just wild mountain vegetables either! We can fish in the river right over there, too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So that means... Wild herbs and fresh vegetables, freshly caught fish, and barbeque? What an athletic, adventurous activity!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Forgive me for jumping to conclusions! You planned this out all for my sake, after all. I'll gladly enjoy it to the fullest!
Barbeque Site

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for the delicious meal!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
That was delicious☆
That was really good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew, I'm stuffed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The wild greens were delicious, and the freshly caught rainbow trout were amazing grilled with salt!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The meat we ordered for extras ended up being a little much... I'm glad we spent all morning moving around.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Thanks to that, we were able to finish everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I must say, I had no idea there were places like this where you can enjoy the bounty of nature so directly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Actually, Haruka and the others told us about this place!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I see! But why would they...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, we were working on the tour plan at school, and we happened to run into them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And when we explained what we were doing, they said they'd love to help come up with fun ideas for your birthday, and we all planned it together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. It sounds like they had quite a store of knowledge to share. I'll have to give Kiritani and the others my thanks soon, as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And to you all. For coming up with such a wonderful plan for my sake...from the bottom of my heart, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We enjoyed heated sports battles and a delicious lunch experience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks to you all, today has been an unforgettable birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... I'm glad you enjoyed yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me, too. But... Don't tell me you think the surprise tour is over already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As they say, “But wait! There's tour!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Surely you mean “But wait, there's more”... But what else could there be?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ahem☆
I will now announce our final destination of the day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here, take this phone♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? There's a call ongoing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Hello! Having fun, Tsukasa?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That voice! Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “That's right! And the final destination for your surprise tour is... Our house!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “We're getting everything ready for your birthday party right now. We have a cake too, so look forward to that!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Okay, see you soon!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And there you have it! That was our special guest, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I utterly let my guard down... I never expected an additional surprise right at the very end...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone! Let us prepare to return home right away! We must rendezvous with Saki and the others as soon as possible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes sir! Time to get cleaning up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We actually have some leeway on time, but seeing how excited Tsukasa is, I feel like we should hurry up and get it done fast.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. Let's not keep him waiting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Roar*
Just you wait, Saki! I'm coming home now!!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa. I never expected to receive a thank-you song from you. It was a real shock.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You say song, but it was practically a mini-musical. And weirdly intense on the direction...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a great song! The acting too, but I guess that's to be expected...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's your birthday, so it feels a little strange that we got something so nice and thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very like Tsukasa, for sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks again, Tsukasa! And very happy birthday, too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu and I picked out your present together, you know! I'll pass it along to Rui next time I see him, so be sure to get it from him♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki spent a very long time debating what kind of hat would best suit you, Tenma. But I think all that worry was worth it in the end, and I hope you'll agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all ready? One, two, three—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I heard you were going to that barbeque spot for lunch today. Did you enjoy yourselves there?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can get some good exercise in, and enjoy fresh food right after. It's the perfect place for you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me, I got a message from Tsukasa earlier. He said they had a lot of fun, and sent along this photo too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww, everyone's enjoying the barbeque together! And Tsukasa's grinning from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it looks like it'll be a wonderful memory for them all. Tsukasa, thank you for the lovely picture. I hope we can all have a barbeque together someday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Happy birthday! I'm so glad you enjoyed your surprise so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You did get back a little sooner than we expected, which caught us off guard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He did say he raced back home as fast as he could for Saki's sake. That's just how Tsukasa is, really.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Definitely. And the party was so much fun... I hope it'll be a fun memory for Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah! Happy birthday again, Tsukasa! You're giving it 100% chasing your dream, so I'll support you 100% too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked our surprise tour.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We got to see sooo much of Tsukasa's smile!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't help but smile myself, seeing you enjoy yourself so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just like a future star to bring such joy to those around him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There definitely are times when you just drag us all around in your wake... But it really is amazing how naturally you can make others smile, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You'll definitely bring smiles to people all around the world someday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all keep on making people smile, Tsukasa! All of us, together☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone! I've received so many kind well-wishes today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Every time I receive such support, I'm reminded... These warm feelings of companionship must never be taken for granted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That is why I treasure the feelings I receive... And seek to repay them with even greater smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Look forward to the continuing career of Tsukasa Tenma, Pegasus Dreamer! Let's meet again on the stage!
